tasks.subject: [community-sign-in-linking] [P1] Gate every implicit link in one account hook
tasks.description: Migration 0031_sign_in_links.sql: pending_sign_in_links(token_hash text PK, user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, provider_id, account_id, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at) + user index; refuse clearly if duplicate account(providerId,accountId) rows exist, then CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on them; add 'account.sign_in_linked' to the notice_outbox kind constraint and NOTICE_KINDS. Config COMMUNITY_OIDC_LINK_VERIFIED_EMAIL ('1' on, unset/'0' off, else refuse; needs the OIDC trio) → config.oidc.linkVerifiedEmail. auth.ts accountLinking: enabled true, disableImplicitLinking false, requireLocalEmailVerified false, trustedProviders [], allowDifferentEmails false. New src/sign-in-link.ts gate called from databaseHooks.account.create.before, in order: credential → allow; request creating a user (WeakSet<ctx> marked in user.create.before) → allow after the named-claim check; (await getOAuthState())?.link?.userId===account.userId → allow (Settings link); else implicit link: signInRefusal → APIError code sign_in_refused; trusted (providerId 'oidc' && linkVerifiedEmail): transaction locking the user row, re-read emailVerified; never confirmed → clearAccountAccess(keepPassword false); audit member.sign_in_linked per membership (changed_fields ['oidc'] or ['oidc','cleared']); queue one account.sign_in_linked notice on the earliest active membership when mail is configured; set signed cookie community_link_notice ('linked'|'linked_cleared'); return the row. Untrusted (OIDC without trust, Google, GitHub): insert pending row (random token, store sha256 hash, 10 min), set signed httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie community_pending_link, throw APIError FORBIDDEN code link_needs_password. Session hook refusal throws code sign_in_refused too. Notice composer for account.sign_in_linked. Integration tests (real Postgres + fake-oidc-issuer): trusted+confirmed; trusted+unconfirmed clean-out; squatter scenario; untrusted issuer takeover test still holds (no link, no session); unconfirmed+untrusted → password path; unverified email → account_not_linked; erasure/closure → sign_in_refused; invited provider sign-up still works with no pending row; signed-in browser without link state is still an implicit link; concurrent double link → one wins; Google/GitHub never auto-link.

tasks.subject: [community-sign-in-linking] [P1] Link with the old password on the same page
tasks.description: Routes in apps/community/src/app.ts with wire schemas in @dorkos/shared/community-wire. POST /api/v1/sign-in-link {password 1..128}: read+verify community_pending_link, row unexpired+unconsumed else 410 LINK_EXPIRED; no credential row → 403 PASSWORD_REQUIRED, nothing spent; spend from the SAME reauth budget key reauth-account:<userId> (spend before verify, refund on success; when spent, consume the pending row and answer 429 with Retry-After); verify with Better Auth's hasher against the credential row, wrong → 403 REAUTH_FAILED; one transaction: lock user FOR UPDATE, re-read credential hash and require it equal to the verified one (else 410), lock pending row, require unconsumed, consume, signInRefusal, insert the account row (unique violation → 409 ALREADY_LINKED), audit member.sign_in_linked [provider,'password'], queue the notice when mail is set; then mint the session via auth.api.signInEmail(asResponse) and forward its Set-Cookie, clear the pending cookie, answer {linked:true}; a refused session leaves the link and returns a clear error. DELETE /api/v1/sign-in-link consumes the row and clears the cookie. GET /api/v1/sign-in-link/notice returns and clears community_link_notice and the pending link's provider label. Tests for every status above plus replay, forged cookie, expiry, password changed between check and link.
